title: Alarm Beeps
blurb: Four sharp alarm beeps that trigger instant low-level panic in any room. It reads as a fire alarm, a microwave, a smoke detector with a dying battery — whatever the listener fears most. That ambiguity is exactly what makes it a top-tier prank sound: play it from a hidden phone and watch everyone perform a full security sweep of the kitchen. Free MP3 download for your traps.
origin: Original synthesis modeled on generic appliance and alarm beeps.
